verdict.rationale: Unreal's own docs cover the build-and-export pipeline from the command line. The cook commandlet (`UnrealEditor.exe <uproject> -run=cook -targetplatform=...`) converts content to platform formats. Unreal Automation Tool is described as a generic system for automating building games, and its command can cook, package and deploy a project. Unreal Build Tool configures the executable build. Together these replace clicking through the editor. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of headless/no-UI flags and CI-system integration guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
